pool.text: The walled city of Tianjin was constructed as a historical milestone.
The Great Mosque, Qingzhen si, was founded in the Muslim quarter.
The Tianjin Prefecture or Zhou was established during the Qing dynasty.
Chinese soldiers boarded a suspicious Hong Kong registered ship named The Arrow.
The orphanage held by the Wanghailou Church faced accusations of kidnapping children.
Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Military Academy for Chinese army officers.
Tianjin was established as a municipality of China because of industry development.
Tianjin Yaohua Middle School was founded in the city.
Tianjin fell to Japan during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
The Chinese Communist Party took control of Tianjin.
Tanggu New Port officially opened its doors for maritime traffic.
The current English spelling of Tianjin was adopted after pinyin introduction.
Construction work on the Tianjin Metro started on July 4.
Tianjin was affected by shock waves during the 7.6 magnitude Tangshan Earthquake.
Tianjin was listed as one of the fourteen coastal open cities.
The Tianjin Metro commenced service after being built in China.
The Great Wall MBA Program was established on a campus.
A railway station was completely rebuilt after finishing work.
The skill of making jianbing guozi was included in lists.
Tianjin held the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit.
